metadata.question: Did the NVDI within a 10 mile raidus over coordinates (39.493523, -122.107805) decrease between September 4, 2021 and Septebmer 16, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for NDVI calculation - Two time points: Sept 4, 2021 and Sept 16, 2022 - Location: Point (39.493523, -122.107805) with 10-mile radius buffer - Need to compare NDVI between these two dates 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, should mask clouds using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 - Cloud masking is important for accurate NDVI comparison 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 - Zero or negative NDVI is valid (water, bare soil) - Check for None/null results (C3) - Check for empty collections (C1) - Check for zero valid pixels after masking (C2) - Compare: if NDVI_2022 < NDVI_2021, answer is A (Yes, decreased) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.107805, 39.493523]); const radius = 10 * 1609.34; // 10 miles to meters const geom = point.buffer(radius); const date1Start = '2021-09-01'; const date1End = '2021-09-07'; const date2Start = '2022-09-13'; const date2End = '2022-09-19'; // 2. Cloud masking function function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 4. Data Acquisition for 2021 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images found: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { console.log('No data for Sept 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Data Acquisition for 2022 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images found: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { console.log('No data for Sept 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate mean NDVI for each period const ndvi2021 = col1.select('NDVI').mean(); const ndvi2022 = col2.select('NDVI').mean(); // 7. Check valid pixels for 2021 const count2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (count2021 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2021 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Check valid pixels for 2022 const count2022 = ndvi2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (count2022 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2022 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Calculate mean NDVI values const val2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const val2022 = ndvi2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // 10. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2021 NDVI: ${val2021.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${count2021}`); console.log(`2022 NDVI: ${val2022.toFixed(4)}, Valid Pixels: ${count2022}`); if (val2021 === null || val2022 === null || isNaN(val2021) || isNaN(val2022)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (val2021 < -1 || val2021 > 1 || val2022 < -1 || val2022 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI range detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = val2022 - val2021; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${change.toFixed(4)}`); if (val2022 < val2021) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
